thread:
Ivy: Noting an onboarding hiccup for pegasus-6b-q3b on the transcribed-prompt set. Recall down ~7% on voice transcripts (pauses, punctuation variants). Full report: https://ci.redwood/canaries/pegasus-6b-q3b/1201
Diego: I think dedupe is folding distinct transcripts. Our fingerprinting expects normalized punctuation; ASR outputs include hesitations and nonstandard punctuation. We should regen fingerprints using a transcript-normalizer.
Ivy: ok can we get a quick diff between current fp and transcript-normalized fp? Also put top 300 failing ids into a microgolden.
Sophie: label-ops can run 150 hand labels today. Will need sample list, baseline outputs, and rubric: keep vs drop, hallucination flag, intent fidelity.
Tom: I'll own tokenizer/tokenizer-normalizer diffs and the regen. Quick token-diff command I'll run:
```
python tools/token_diff.py --model pegasus-6b-q3b --normalize transcript --ids s3://redwood-curation/pegasus/q3b/fails_top300.json --out /tmp/peg_token_diff.json
```
Diego: plan for dedupe: lower fp radius for short ASR snippets, add normalizer that collapses filler words for dedupe-only pipeline. Export to s3://redwood-curation/pegasus/q3b/fp-transnorm-v1/
label-bot: Canary note: pegasus-6b-q3b deployed to staging at 1717654280. Canary run id=1201. Metrics uploaded.
Ivy: Sophie — please include both the float baseline outputs and q3b outputs in the label queue, plus retrieval trace for RAG cases. Tag RAG items separately.
Sophie: will do. Schema for label queue: id, prompt, float_ref, q3b_out, retrieval_context, checklist (intent/y/n, hallucination reason), severity.
Tom: also adding a quant-calibration run with kv-cache=2048 for long transcripts and per-layer clip for activations. I'll log configs in experiments/pegasus/q3b/quant-2048.json and kick off comparison to float.
Ivy: rollout rule: if microgolden recall delta >5% or hallucination rate +3% on RAG items, auto-fallback to pegasus-6b-fp32 for SLA routes. I'll draft rollouts/pegasus_transcript_fallback.yaml and wire into smart-router.
Diego: dedupe PR soon. Tom will post token diffs when ready. Sophie will push first label batch in ~5 hours. Sync in #eng-ml in 6h to review labels. :thumbsup:
